title: Egelund House
text: Egelund House (Danish: Egelund Slot) is a former royal residence built by Queen Dowager Louise Josephine from 1915 to 1917 on the road between Hillerød and Fredensborg, near the village of Nødebo and the southern tip of Lake Esrom, 35 km north of Copenhagen, Denmark. Today it is owned by Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and used as a congress and training centre.

title: Respect to Mehmetçik Monument
text: The Respect to Mehmetçik Memorial (Turkish: "Mehmetçiğe Saygı Anıtı" ) is a monument in the Gallipoli peninsula, Turkey. Mehmetçik is a common name given to soldiers in a war, just like G.I..
